sources.title: Gemma 4 model overview - Google AI for Developers
sources.snippet: Gemma is a family of generative artificial intelligence models and you can use them in a wide variety of generation tasks, including question answering, summarization, and reasoning. sources.title: Gemma 4 | Google AI Edge | Google for Developers
sources.snippet: Recommendations: MTP is universally recommended for all tasks on GPU backends and for the Gemma4-E4B model on CPU. For the Gemma4-E2B model on CPU, it is highly valuable for rewrite, summarize, and coding tasks, but should be enabled selectively as it may cause a slight slowdown during freeform prompting or generative tasks.
